title: setup enables project plugins that doctor says are missing
what: After relay setup, relay doctor reports no plugin as not installed: setup installs the plugins it enables at project scope, or puts the exact command in its to-do list.
why: 25 Oct, the throwaway project (scratchpad reports/demo-and-release.md, part 1): setup enabled core, delegate, front and observe in .claude/settings.json; relay doctor then gave 4 FIX "not installed at project scope", and setup's to-do list did not name the install. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: relay setup <tmp project> then relay doctor <tmp project>: FIX lines for core, delegate, front, observe; the setup output has no install command for them.
pass_cases: After setup, doctor has no "not installed" FIX, or setup's to-do names `claude plugin install <name>@relay --scope project` for each.
